overview: The Sonic Wolf Denlands are the echoing ridge territory of the Sonic Wolf tribe.
history: The denlands formed around ancient echo caverns.
Pack leaders established ritual howling sites to amplify their calls.
Echo shamans learned to manipulate resonant caverns for tribal rites.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, denland raids intensified.
Sonic Wolf raiders expanded pack-run trails across the ridges.
hooks: A pack leader calls for a raid.
An echo cavern destabilizes after a ritual.
A howling site emits dangerous resonance.
A Sonic Wolf shaman seeks aid with a ritual gone wrong.
